package scopetest

import (
	"context"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	scopes "example.com/scopetest/gen/scopes"
	"github.com/CaliLuke/loom/security"
)

type scopeService struct {
	calls []string
}

func TestScopeCallbacks(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, method string
		grants       map[string][]string
		wantCalls    []string
		wantError    bool
	}{
		{"machine scope", "flow", map[string][]string{"oauth": {"machine"}}, []string{"oauth"}, false},
		{"machine scope missing", "flow", map[string][]string{"oauth": {"oauth"}}, []string{"oauth"}, true},
		{"isolated valid", "isolated", map[string][]string{"oauth": {"shared"}, "second": {"oauth"}, "key": {"admin"}}, []string{"oauth", "second", "key"}, false},
		{"isolated missing role", "isolated", map[string][]string{"oauth": {"shared"}, "second": {"oauth"}}, []string{"oauth", "second", "key"}, true},
		{"isolated wrong scheme grant", "isolated", map[string][]string{"oauth": {"oauth"}, "second": {"shared"}, "key": {"admin"}}, []string{"oauth"}, true},
		{"compound valid", "compound", map[string][]string{"basic": {"shared", "basic"}, "key": {"shared", "key"}, "jwt": {"shared", "read"}, "oauth": {"shared", "oauth"}}, []string{"basic", "key", "jwt", "oauth"}, false},
		{"compound missing", "compound", map[string][]string{"basic": {"basic"}}, []string{"basic"}, true},
		{"first alternative", "alternative", map[string][]string{"jwt": {"read"}}, []string{"jwt", "unscoped"}, false},
		{"second alternative", "alternative", map[string][]string{"jwt": {"write"}}, []string{"jwt", "jwt", "unscoped"}, false},
		{"no alternative", "alternative", nil, []string{"jwt", "jwt"}, true},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			svc := &scopeService{}
			var authCalls []string
			check := func(name string, declared, required []string) {
				authCalls = append(authCalls, strings.TrimPrefix(name, "scope_"))
				for _, scope := range required {
					if tc.method == "isolated" && name == "key" {
						continue
					}
					require.True(t, slices.Contains(declared, scope), "%s requires undeclared %s", name, scope)
				}
			}
			basic := func(ctx context.Context, _, _ string, s *security.BasicScheme) (context.Context, error) {
				check(s.Name, s.Scopes, s.RequiredScopes)
				return ctx, s.Validate(tc.grants[strings.TrimPrefix(s.Name, "scope_")])
			}
			key := func(ctx context.Context, _ string, s *security.APIKeyScheme) (context.Context, error) {
				check(s.Name, s.Scopes, s.RequiredScopes)
				return ctx, s.Validate(tc.grants[strings.TrimPrefix(s.Name, "scope_")])
			}
			jwt := func(ctx context.Context, _ string, s *security.JWTScheme) (context.Context, error) {
				check(s.Name, s.Scopes, s.RequiredScopes)
				return ctx, s.Validate(tc.grants[strings.TrimPrefix(s.Name, "scope_")])
			}
			oauth := func(ctx context.Context, _ string, s *security.OAuth2Scheme) (context.Context, error) {
				check(s.Name, s.Scopes, s.RequiredScopes)
				if s.Name == "oauth" {
					require.Len(t, s.Flows, 3)
					require.Equal(t, map[string]string{"oauth": "User consent", "shared": "User grant"}, s.Flows[0].Scopes)
					require.Equal(t, map[string]string{"machine": "Machine grant", "shared": "Machine permission"}, s.Flows[1].Scopes)
					require.NotNil(t, s.Flows[2].Scopes)
					require.Empty(t, s.Flows[2].Scopes)
				}
				if s.Name == "second" {
					require.Len(t, s.Flows, 2)
					require.Equal(t, map[string]string{"oauth": "no description", "shared": "no description"}, s.Flows[0].Scopes)
					require.NotNil(t, s.Flows[1].Scopes)
					require.Empty(t, s.Flows[1].Scopes)
				}
				return ctx, s.Validate(tc.grants[strings.TrimPrefix(s.Name, "scope_")])
			}
			var err error
			switch tc.method {
			case "flow":
				endpoint := scopes.NewFlowEndpoint(svc, oauth)
				_, err = endpoint(context.Background(), &scopes.FlowPayload{Token: "token"})
			case "isolated":
				endpoint := scopes.NewIsolatedEndpoint(svc, oauth, key)
				_, err = endpoint(context.Background(), &scopes.IsolatedPayload{Token: "token", Key: "key"})
			case "compound":
				endpoint := scopes.NewCompoundEndpoint(svc, basic, key, jwt, oauth)
				_, err = endpoint(context.Background(), &scopes.CompoundPayload{User: "user", Password: "pass", Key: "key", Token: "jwt", Access: "oauth"})
			case "alternative":
				endpoint := scopes.NewAlternativeEndpoint(svc, jwt, key)
				_, err = endpoint(context.Background(), &scopes.AlternativePayload{Token: "jwt", Key: "key"})
			default:
				t.Fatalf("unknown method %q", tc.method)
			}
			if tc.wantError {
				require.Error(t, err)
				require.True(t, strings.Contains(err.Error(), "missing scopes"), err)
				require.Empty(t, svc.calls)
			} else {
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Equal(t, []string{tc.method}, svc.calls)
			}
			require.Equal(t, tc.wantCalls, authCalls)
		})
	}
}

func (s *scopeService) Compound(context.Context, *scopes.CompoundPayload) error {
	s.calls = append(s.calls, "compound")
	return nil
}

func (s *scopeService) Alternative(context.Context, *scopes.AlternativePayload) error {
	s.calls = append(s.calls, "alternative")
	return nil
}

func (s *scopeService) Isolated(context.Context, *scopes.IsolatedPayload) error {
	s.calls = append(s.calls, "isolated")
	return nil
}

func (s *scopeService) Flow(context.Context, *scopes.FlowPayload) error {
	s.calls = append(s.calls, "flow")
	return nil
}
